title: Rapid Nuclei Isolation from Human Brain
author: Fatma Ayhan
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.scpeavn
materials: Dounce homogenize tissue samples (smaller than 0.5 cm) or cell pellets in 2 ml of ice-cold Nuclei EZ lysis buffer (Sigma, #EZ PREP NUC-101). Dounce tissue 20-25 times with pestle A, followed by 20-25 times with pestle B while on ice.

steps.title: Prepare Nuclei Suspension Buffer (NSB)
steps.instruction: Prepare the NSB based on the intended downstream application.

substeps.instruction: For drop-seq: Use 1x PBS, 0.01% BSA (ultra pure), and 0.2U/ul RNAse inhibitor.
For 10X Genomics: Use 1X PBS, 1% BSA (ultra pure), and 0.2U/ul RNAse inhibitor.

steps.title: Initial Lysis and Incubation
steps.instruction: Perform initial lysis of the sample on ice.

substeps.instruction: Move sample to a 15 ml conical tube.
Add 2 ml of ice-cold Nuclei EZ lysis buffer.

steps.title: First Nuclei Collection and Wash
steps.instruction: Collect nuclei and perform a wash step using lysis buffer.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 500 x g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Carefully resuspend nuclei in 4 ml of ice-cold Nuclei EZ lysis buffer.

steps.title: Final Collection and Filtration
steps.instruction: Isolate nuclei and filter the suspension.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 500 x g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Resuspend isolated nuclei in 1 ml of NSB.
Filter the suspension through a Flowmi Cell Strainer (Bel-Art, H13680-0040).

steps.title: Quantify Nuclei
steps.instruction: Count the nuclei in the suspension.

substeps.instruction: Stain 10μl of nuclei suspension with either DAPI (1:5000) or 0.4% Trypan Blue.

steps.title: Adjust Nuclei Concentration
steps.instruction: Adjust the final volume of the suspension using NSB to reach the required concentration.
